top_signals.title: BlackRock's Hambro Sees New Commodity Cycle
top_signals.summary: BlackRock’s Evy Hambro argues that commodities are entering a new cycle driven by AI, electrification, and years of supply underinvestment. He believes tight supply will keep prices supported over the long term. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
